description: Header file defining allocator factory functions and constants for audio memory management in Android's AudioFlinger service.

methods.name: getDedicated
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to a dedicated memory allocator with size DED_SIZE.

methods.name: getSharedLarge
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to a large shared memory allocator with size SHARED_SIZE_LARGE.

methods.name: getSharedSmall
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to a small shared memory allocator with size SHARED_SIZE_SMALL.

methods.name: wrapWithPolicySnooping
methods.description: Wraps an allocator with a policy snooping layer for monitoring.

methods.name: getClientAllocator
methods.description: Creates and returns a composite client allocator managing dedicated and shared pools.
